## Notes

In the three high-burden areas, G6PD testing will be rolled out with high dose 7-day PQ. G6PD normal will receive the "optimal" dose, intermediates will received 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days, deficient provided 8 week. Follow up of patients will remain the same
